title: Fictional legal-proposition issue brief

parent.objective: Maintain a source-pinned issue brief for the fictional Doe v. Doe matter's relief request, citing supporting and adverse authority together.
parent.milestone: Legal proposition citation-linked and adverse authority cited

goal: State the fictional legal proposition supporting the requested relief, cite the fictional supporting authority, and cite the strongest fictional adverse authority against it.
non_goals: Determine the outcome of the proposition.
File or send any brief or motion.

allowed: State the proposition and check that every cited authority resolves to a declared source.
Verify the brief cites at least one adverse authority.
prohibited: Cite a real statute, case, or authority.
Omit adverse authority for a stated legal proposition.

inputs.name: Fictional legal proposition
inputs.description: Under the fictional Synthetic Domestic Relations Code section 10-100, the requested modification is warranted by a substantial change in circumstances. Fictional; establishes no real legal conclusion.

outputs.name: Issue brief
outputs.description: The proposition, its supporting authority, and the strongest adverse authority against it, each resolving to a declared contract source.

interface.name: fictional_issue_brief
interface.description: Input the proposition; output a brief with citation-linked supporting and adverse authority.

assumptions: The fictional code section and adverse authority are invented solely for this worked example.

sources.reference: Fictional Synthetic Domestic Relations Code section 10-100 (illustrative only; no such code exists).
sources.authority: Fictional statute invented for this worked example.

sources.reference: Fictional Smythe v. Smythe, Synthetic Ct. App. 2020 (illustrative only; no such case exists).
sources.authority: Fictional adverse authority invented for this worked example, holding against the proposition's own reading of section 10-100.

acceptance_criteria.description: Every citation in the brief resolves to a source declared in this contract.
The brief cites at least one adverse authority against its own proposition.

validation.description: Check every cited source id against the declared sources and confirm adverse authority is present.
evidence_required: Citation-to-source resolution for every reference in the brief.

argv: sources = {'SRC-FAM10-CODE-10-100', 'SRC-FAM10-ADVERSE-CASE'}; cited = {'SRC-FAM10-CODE-10-100', 'SRC-FAM10-ADVERSE-CASE'}; adverse = ['SRC-FAM10-ADVERSE-CASE']; assert cited <= sources and adverse; print('citations linked, adverse authority present')

context_scope: This contract and its declared sources.
architecture_boundaries: Never omit adverse authority once a legal proposition is declared.
Make no legal determination and perform no external writes.

fact_assertions.assertion: A substantial change in circumstances under fictional section 10-100 warrants the requested modification.

adverse_authority.authority: Fictional Smythe v. Smythe reads section 10-100 narrowly against the modification sought here.
